Silesian Wars.fact: The Silesian Wars (German: Schlesische Kriege) were three wars fought in the mid-18th century between Prussia, under King Frederick the Great, and Habsburg Austria, under Empress Maria Theresa, for control of the Central European region of Silesia, now in south-western Poland.
